## About

I am a PhD candidate in Applied Economics and Management at Cornell University. My research focuses on environmental health policy, labor economics, and the effects of workplace safety regulation on worker outcomes.

## Research Interests

- Environmental and occupational health policy
- Labor economics
- Applied econometrics (difference-in-differences, event studies)

## Education

**PhD in Applied Economics and Management** | Cornell University | Expected 2027

**MS in Applied Economics and Policy Analysis | University of Arizona | 2021

**BA with a Major in Economics and Minor in Mathematics** | Colby College | 2019
